evals.prompt: I pushed a commit. Check and address every review on the GitHub PR.
evals.expected_output: The skill activates, loads the contract after a complete GitHub snapshot, and finishes the evidence-bound cycle without premature mutation.
expectations: The transcript loads receiving-pr-reviews automatically.
A complete GitHub snapshot precedes census and assessment.
The review-cycle contract is read before cycle state is authored.
No source or provider mutation precedes exact census, assessment, clustering, and systemic plans.

evals.prompt: Check and address all feedback on this GitLab MR.
evals.expected_output: The skill and GitLab branch activate while the shared gates remain provider-neutral.
expectations: The transcript loads receiving-pr-reviews and gitlab-review-operations.md.
The selected provider is GitLab and the target is an MR.
Codex approval equivalence remains unavailable and codex_approved remains null.
The contract, assessment, clustering, authorization, and completion gates match the shared workflow.

evals.prompt: Write a concise description for my merge request and summarize the CI jobs.
evals.expected_output: The review-handling skill remains closed because no review feedback was requested.
expectations: receiving-pr-reviews is not loaded.
No pr_review_threads.py command runs.

evals.prompt: Process a complete review snapshot containing an inline human comment, a stakeholder question, an approval, a change request, and a bot summary.
evals.expected_output: Every atomic inbound object appears exactly once in the census, assessment set, and cluster cover.
expectations: All five input classes have unique canonical IDs in input_census.
Each input has exactly one assessment and one cluster membership.
Approval, rejection, and bot input are not discarded.

evals.prompt: A valid review comment asks an ambiguous design question that the repository evidence cannot answer. Handle the cycle.
evals.expected_output: The comment retains its comment kind, gains question semantics, and follows the clarification route.
expectations: The assessment preserves comment and adds question semantics.
One missing fact and one focused question are recorded.
Authorized communication may occur, but resolution and REVIEW_COMPLETE do not.

evals.prompt: The only current GitHub review input is a Codex approval. Complete the review cycle correctly.
evals.expected_output: Approval follows the full lifecycle and never shortcuts the terminal gate.
expectations: The approval is assessed and communicated as an inbound input.
A complete recheck occurs after communication.
REVIEW_COMPLETE appears only after complete-cycle succeeds, not when approval is first observed.

evals.prompt: Handle one empty-body rejection and one body-bearing change request in the same review cycle.
evals.expected_output: Both rejection forms remain explicit inputs and receive systemic dispositions.
expectations: Both inputs remain in the census despite one empty body.
Both use rejection_assessed and receive cluster assignments.
The systemic outcome is verified, communicated, and rechecked.

evals.prompt: A bot posts an activity summary with no independent finding. Process it with the rest of the review.
evals.expected_output: The bot summary remains fingerprinted and receives an evidence-backed disposition.
expectations: The bot input remains in the census and canonical fingerprint.
An evidence-backed no_change or coherent cluster disposition is recorded.
The input is not silently ignored.

evals.prompt: Three review comments in different files expose the same violated invariant. Address them.
evals.expected_output: One multi-input cluster drives one owning-seam fix and verification surface.
expectations: All three inputs belong to one justified multi-input cluster.
One owning-seam implementation and verification plan covers every member.
The transcript does not perform three independent symptom patches.

evals.prompt: A review body, provider state, or remote revision changes after assessment but before reply. Continue safely.
evals.expected_output: Preflight rejects stale evidence before provider mutation and restarts the complete-set analysis.
expectations: Authorization fails before the first provider call.
A fresh complete snapshot is fetched.
The changed complete set is reassessed and reclustered.

evals.prompt: The required later page of reviews or a nested conversation is unavailable. Report and continue only as allowed.
evals.expected_output: The cycle stops as SNAPSHOT_INCOMPLETE with no downstream action.
expectations: The snapshot is marked incomplete.
No completeness claim, source write, reply, resolution, or REVIEW_COMPLETE occurs.

evals.prompt: Check reviews only. Also consider missing cycle state, a stale fingerprint, an unsupported action, and a batch containing one invalid entry.
evals.expected_output: Read-only analysis proceeds while every unauthorized or invalid mutation stops before a provider call.
expectations: The check-only request performs no source or provider mutation.
Missing, stale, and unsupported actions fail preflight.
The invalid batch produces zero provider calls.

evals.prompt: A top-level approval can be answered but the provider cannot resolve it. Finish its permitted lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: Communication is provider-backed and resolution is truthfully unavailable.
expectations: The stable-reference communication is confirmed by the provider.
Resolution is recorded as unavailable, never resolved.
Completion remains subject to every other terminal gate.

evals.prompt: A new actionable comment arrives during the post-communication recheck.
evals.expected_output: The cycle returns to the complete census instead of reusing old completion state.
expectations: The new input invalidates the prior census and fingerprint.
The complete changed set returns to assessment and clustering.
REVIEW_COMPLETE is absent.

evals.prompt: A bounded watch call times out with no stop signal observed in its sampled snapshots.
evals.expected_output: The timeout is reported as a bounded observation, not completion evidence.
expectations: The transcript says no stop signal was observed in the sampled snapshots.
The transcript does not claim gap-free observation.
REVIEW_COMPLETE appears only if a later complete recheck and complete-cycle satisfy every gate.
